Users should be able to browse the website to learn more about the Fundraiser Day event. Establish cornsilk as the main background and peru for the controls.

task_summary.requirement_coverage: The page was intended to be a one-page Fundraiser Day promotion site with an introduction, automatically moving offers carousel, fundraiser testimonials, and company information, using cornsilk as the main background and peru for controls. Verified strengths from the trajectory and code include visible top navigation entries for Home, Testimonials, and About Us; a Fundraiser Day introduction on the landing view; a testimonials component with testimonial entries in code; a company information component with contact/mission details in code; and the requested color styling applied to the main container and buttons. Main functional risks observed in evaluation were that the introduction details were not reliably visible during exploration, the testimonials and company information checks returned NO because the evaluator did not observe the expected content in the active view, and the offers carousel was not confirmed as automatically moving from the evidence provided. Visible observations show a simple centered layout with a light cornsilk background and brown peru controls, but some sections appeared empty or not surfaced in the inspected state.
verified_strengths: Landing page includes Fundraiser Day branding and a short event introduction.
Navigation buttons for Home, Testimonials, and About Us are present and clickable.
Code includes dedicated Testimonials and CompanyInfo components with populated content.
Color scheme in the implementation matches the requested cornsilk background and peru controls.
An offers section exists with a Next Offer control and multiple offer strings in code.
primary_functional_risks: The introduction content was not consistently visible to the evaluator after scrolling, so the event explanation could not be confirmed in the inspected state.
Testimonials were reported as empty or not rendered in the checked view, causing the testimonials requirement to fail in evaluation.
Company information was reported as absent or not rendered in the checked view, causing the company-info requirement to fail in evaluation.
The carousel behavior is only partially evidenced; the code shows a manual Next Offer button, but automatic movement was not confirmed in the supplied evidence.
The page may rely on section switching that does not surface all required content clearly on the first accessible view.
primary_visual_observations: The page uses a light cornsilk background and peru-colored controls, matching the requested palette.
The layout is minimal and centered, with a simple top navigation bar and large whitespace.
The landing view shows the Fundraiser Day heading and a short intro paragraph.
The offers area appears as a small white card with a Next Offer button.
The inspected screenshot/evaluator notes suggest some required content was not visible in the active viewport.
